premises.text: A custom digital gnome lives on only one device at a time, travels with check-ins and photos, and can be handed to friends who continue its journey with notifications to prior holders
premises.evidence_span: a gnome can only live on one device

premises.text: Lift transfers a gnome between devices through a camera viewfinder in a magical handoff
Lyft enables drag-and-drop transfer of photos and objects across separate devices through the screen
premises.evidence_span: a different way of device interconnectivity

value.text: Playful persistent digital objects and richer interconnectivity across personal devices
value.evidence_span: wouldn't it be cool to have a gnome in your pocket

causal_links.evidence_span: take pictures with him, to take him to different venues
connect them in a more interesting way

notes: Churn Labs greenfield exploration framing not coded as premise. Custom create vs lift handoff folded into one unique-device gnome object with transfer as mechanism package; Lyft photo drag-drop split as separately demoed interconnectivity module. Mileage/traction of Lebowski excluded. Humorous anti-need opener treated as framing. Two domains.
